raw:
Agent Name: Bioinformatics_Expert  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Bioinformatics_Expert was responsible for finding links to the most relevant dog genome assemblies as of May 2020. The results included various links to different genome assemblies, but they failed to identify the specific and correct FTP link (ftp://ftp.broadinstitute.org/distribution/assemblies/mammals/dog/canFam3.1/) which was the most relevant. The error occurred here as the expert did not correctly identify and provide the direct link to the CanFam3.1 assembly via the Broad Institute resource, which was significant in May 2020. This led to the Verification_Expert and the final answer being incorrectly focused on other assemblies rather than the specified one.
